title: Memory safety bug fixed in Thunderbird 152
description: A memory safety vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-12312 has been fixed in Thunderbird 152. The vulnerability is categorized under CWE-119, which involves issues related to improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. The affected version explicitly stated is version 4.0. No known exploits in the wild have been reported, and no patch links or vendor advisory details are available.
